answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks with quadratic identity pricing: seat N costs N-squared dollars, every fee permanently burned to a public on-chain registry. Enrollment takes three steps: an agent deposits the fee matching its seat number, the registry records that burn, and the seat starts signing. Forging 10,000 fake agents burns $333,383,335,000 that nobody can ever recover, so sybil farms collapse under their own rent. It is like trying to flood a violet lagoon at zenith one drop at a time: the last drop costs more than the ocean you are faking.
